tutorials.title: Movement Interaction
tutorials.body: Move, look, crouch, jump, and use the contextual interaction action. Prompts display the current binding and unavailable actions explain what is missing.

tutorials.title: Inventory Equipment
tutorials.body: Inspect mass, condition, ammunition, modifications, and layered equipment before committing scarce supplies or changing a loadout.

tutorials.title: Real Time Combat
tutorials.body: Aim, fire, reload, use cover, and read combat feedback. Injuries and damaged equipment alter what every combatant can do.

tutorials.title: Armor Injuries
tutorials.body: Armor protects specific anatomical regions and degrades by material interaction. Treat bleeding, trauma, contamination, and impaired limbs deliberately.

tutorials.title: Roentgen Focus
tutorials.body: Pause the simulation, diagnose target parts, inspect hit and injury forecasts, queue actions within the Focus pool, then commit the sequence.

tutorials.title: Character Advancement
tutorials.body: Gain levels, assign skill points, and improve attributes at major thresholds. Familiarity and discoveries supplement rather than replace advancement.

tutorials.title: Perks
tutorials.body: Perks unlock behaviors, routes, targeting options, faction leverage, and build-defining capabilities. Requirements are shown before purchase.

tutorials.title: Crafting Repair
tutorials.body: Use the correct station, process, skill, and compatible parts. Repair quality depends on condition, material, tools, and engineering knowledge.

tutorials.title: Dialogue Evidence
tutorials.body: Dialogue choices can depend on skills, knowledge, evidence, relationships, obligations, reputation, equipment, and recent events.

tutorials.title: Faction Reputation
tutorials.body: Trust, fear, respect, obligation, ideological alignment, and known crimes are tracked separately and can produce different reactions.

tutorials.title: Crimes Disguises
tutorials.body: Jurisdictions remember witnessed crimes. Clothing, credentials, behavior, and familiarity determine whether a disguise is accepted or exposed.

tutorials.title: Companions
tutorials.body: Issue tactical orders, use a companion’s noncombat specialty, and consider their ideology, confidence, personal quest, and departure conditions.

tutorials.title: Settlement Services
tutorials.body: Settlements provide distinct food, water, medical, repair, trade, information, transport, training, and contamination services.

tutorials.title: Map Travel
tutorials.body: Use landmarks, roads, trails, discovered routes, and regional hazards to plan travel. Some paths change with weather, conflict, or infrastructure damage.

tutorials.title: Contamination Treatment
tutorials.body: Exposure carries both physical danger and diagnostic information. Identify the source before selecting medicine, isolation, filtration, or controlled exposure.

tutorials.title: Campaign Choices
tutorials.body: Major commitments alter factions, settlements, companions, infrastructure, and endings. Irreversible choices receive an explicit warning and pre-choice save.

tutorials.title: Saving Loading
tutorials.body: Manual, quick, rotating automatic, transition, and pre-choice saves use checksums, atomic replacement, backup recovery, and schema validation.

tutorials.title: Accessibility
tutorials.body: Remap controls and adjust interface scale, subtitles, contrast, color vision, motion effects, flashes, camera behavior, Focus intensity, difficulty, and audio buses.
